title: The xd Crossword Corpus
description:
The xd Crossword Corpus is the world's largest collection of crossword puzzles, with more than 160,000 published crosswords from over 160 publications, from 1913 to today, kept in a plain-text format (.xd) for research and preservation. Every puzzle is stored as one file holding its grid, clues, answers and publication details, together with a record of where it came from for nearly every puzzle.

This record describes the corpus as a whole. The files in this record are a snapshot of the century-arcade/xd repository: the corpus's policy documents (collection scope, editorial practice, access terms, datasets, preservation, governance and decisions, in docs/), the .xd format specification and the tools that build the corpus, not the puzzles. Most puzzles are still under copyright, so the corpus itself is private; it is available for research on request, in forms from aggregate statistics to the full collection. See ACCESS.md for what is available, how to ask, and the terms. The record is a snapshot of the xd repository under the MIT license; the policy documents in docs/ may also be used under CC-BY-4.0. No puzzles are included; they remain the property of their publishers and constructors.

To cite: Pwanson, Saul and DeJarnatt, Alex. (year accessed). The xd Crossword Corpus. Century Arcade. https://centuryarcade.org/xd/
